target_customer: Hardware and robotics engineering teams in robotics, aerospace, defense, automotive, industrial and semiconductor equipment
problem: Teams shipping robots and IoT devices cannot easily see which fleet units run which software and what change caused a failure.
business_model: B2B SaaS, device-agent based observability (pricing not public)

founders.name: Shivani Mouleeswaran
founders.background_notes: Education not listed on the YC page.

founders.name: Ritika Shrivastava
founders.background_notes: Researched and taught computer vision and robotics at Berkeley per the YC page.

competitors.name: Foxglove
competitors.what: Robotics data visualization and observability platform (Foxglove 2.0 merged Studio and Data Platform)

technical_complexity.rationale: On-device agent with offline-first capture, fleet inventory and release correlation is standard distributed systems work, with hardware diversity as the hard part.

defensibility.rationale: Telemetry agents are copyable and Foxglove was already an established category player; value comes from fleet history lock-in once installed.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No acquisition or incumbent copy found as of 2026-11.

market_need_then: Robotics teams were scaling fleets in 2024, and Foxglove's March 2024 relaunch around observability shows vendors saw demand for the category.

branding.domain_note: Uses emberrobotics.com with the Robotics suffix, since Ember.js and other Ember brands dominate search.

identity.logo: Small mark hosted by YC; no description found
identity.voice_and_tone: Plain and direct: 'Know what changed. Know what failed.'

brand_strength.rationale: Search results are dominated by Ember.js; the one memorable asset is the Datadog for robots tagline on the YC listing.

outcome_analysis: Ember Robotics is active as of the latest sources, a two person team founded by two former Tesla Autopilot engineers. Its early positioning as Datadog for robots and camera diagnostics has broadened to fleet status and release tracking. No public funding beyond YC, no customers named and no outcome events found, so success or failure cannot be judged yet.
notes: Aggregators (VCBacked, Extruct, Caplight) list a roughly $500K seed dated 2024-09 with Y Combinator, Lombardstreet Ventures, Tango.vc, Orange Collective and Trucks VC; seen only on aggregators, so unverified and not recorded as a round. A $3.2M seed (StartupIntros, 2025-09) and a $4.3M round on CB Insights are likely other companies. Competitor list is thin; Rerun existed but no dated source was found. Completeness pass: the 500K pre-seed (2024-09) is now recorded from aggregators (VCBacked, StartupIntros, Extruct); a single class of database source, no press release. Tango.vc, Orange Collective and Trucks VC named earlier by Caplight were not confirmed in a second search, so not listed as investors. Stage is labeled pre-seed or seed by different sources.
